## TRA Timeline

#### Up-C IPO and TRA execution

- 2020-12-30: Form-of TRA filed as Exhibit 10.2 to S-1 with "[DATE]" preamble placeholder
- 2021-01-29: Up-C IPO closes; TRA executed at 85% sharing rate with Oaktree Power, founder Dean Solon, and Exchange/Reorganization TRA Holders

#### Negotiated termination

- 2022-11-29: TRA Amendment executed inserting a fixed $58.0M Aggregate Early Termination Payment, replacing the contract's Section 4.1 mechanism
- 2022-12-06: Company exercises termination right concurrent with follow-on Class A offering; $58M paid pro-rata to TRA Holders
- 2023-02-28: FY2022 10-K reports $110.9M gain on termination (TRA carrying value less $58M payment), implying the negotiated payment was materially below the contract's pre-amendment ETP formula

## Explanation

Shoals Technologies Group, Inc. executed a Tax Receivable Agreement on January 29, 2021 at its Up-C IPO close, paying 85% of cumulative net realized tax benefits to Oaktree Power Opportunities Fund IV, founder Dean Solon, and the Exchange/Reorganization TRA Holders. Covered attributes included Section 754 basis step-ups from LLC Interest exchanges plus pre-IPO Closing Date Basis. Less than two years later, the parties negotiated a terminating amendment dated November 29, 2022, substituting a fixed $58.0M Aggregate Early Termination Payment for the contract's normal ETP formula; Shoals exercised the new termination right on December 6, 2022 concurrent with a Class A follow-on offering. The $110.9M gain on termination indicates the negotiated payment was materially below the pre-amendment ETP value. The TRA remains terminated as of the FY2025 10-K with no successor agreement. See `contract_log.md` for the amendment text and the operative-section changes.
